size_band: 280+ employees at peak, ~120 laid off at closure
the_problem: Will Der SA, maker of apparel for Adidas, Puma, Lacoste, Fila and others, saw orders collapse amid an Argentine textile slump (sector output -25.6% y/y in May, plants at 42.2% capacity), with 11 bounced cheques worth ARS 24.69M unregularised.
the_decision: Partners closed the General Pacheco and Las Flores plants and dismissed 120 workers. President Santiago Phelan told staff: "estamos en agosto y ahora no hay laburo" after failing to find substitute work, and partner Armando Anasal blamed policy: "la política nos hundió".
the_outcome: Two plants closed, 120 jobs lost, headcount down to roughly a third of the earlier ~370 (300 Buenos Aires + 70 Catamarca); severance uncertain (Phelan: "se va a pagar lo que se puede pagar, puede ser todo o puede ser nada").
